Usage: ryi query [OPTIONS] [PATH]...
Run a tree-sitter query over files
e.g. ryi query --query '(function_item name: (identifier) @n)' src/
Input: --entry <FILE> --depth <N> --root <DIR>
Flags: --pattern <GLOB> --lang <LANG> --query <QUERY> --scm <FILE> --scmpp <FILE> --digest <DIGEST> --sqlite <PATH> --timeout <SECS>
